description: This file defines the CanvasManager class, responsible for displaying, hiding, and managing a canvas interface within a macOS app. It includes methods for showing panels, handling gateway updates, auto-navigation, and URL resolution related to the canvas feature.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: The singleton class responsible for managing canvas sessions, including display, navigation, and interactions with gateway updates.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the canvas session with a specified session key and optional target path, returning the directory path.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Shows the canvas with detailed parameters including session key, target path, and placement, and returns a CanvasShowResult object.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas session associated with the given session key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the context of the current canvas session asynchronously.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current canvas and saves it to the specified output path asynchronously.
